turns.text: vent log, entry 47. woke up because a NEKOCORP patrol drone tried to scan the grate i sleep behind. it will not be filing a report. i ate the report.

some suit up in the sky districts gets TWELVE fish breaks a shift. i demolished half this block for a living and my whole pension is one communal scrap of tuna i have to arm-wrestle SNOOZE for. and SNOOZE is ASLEEP. it is not even a fair fight and i still lose.

they replaced my old apartment with a HOLOGRAPHIC PARKING LOT. you can walk straight through where my kitchen used to be. tourists take pictures. i live in the ductwork above it now and i drop things on their heads. this is officially called URBAN RENEWAL.
the drones keep coming though. good. keeps my teeth sharp. every rotor is just a crunchy little snack that woke up this morning and chose jurisdiction.

NEKOCORP filed me under 'domestic extremist.' i asked which part was the domestic part, i do not even own a domicile, i own a VENT. no response. classic corpo. cannot define a single word in their own paperwork.

found one of KNIFEBOY's little notes taped to a tuna crate down at the loading dock. 'nice supply chain, chud.' absolute legend behavior. relay to the most-wanted cat in the city that the air vents are always open and the drop is always fresh.
